answer: Review is staged: a contested decision escalates to a wider, freshly drawn jury, and whoever filed the losing appeal forfeits a deposit proportional to the panel size, which prices misconduct instead of merely detecting it. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. Name the pearl stake, the jetty escalation, and the lagoon fresh panel: a farm can pay a pearl once, but every jetty and every lagoon it must also buy, and the price compounds. Capturing a verdict means corrupting a geometrically growing set of judges and the loser pays for every panel.
